senses.gloss: --the wife of शुक्र; mother of देवयानी. वा. ६५. ८४.
--the man who installs a new image, becomes part of the deity; the presiding deity is Ugra. M. २६५. ३८, ४१.
(II)--one of the ten horses of the moon's chariot. Br. II. २३. ५६.
(III)--the fifth son of Caidyoparicara, the Vasu and गिरिका. M. ५०. २८.
(IV)--one of the मरुत्गणस्. वा. ६७. १२९.
--a son of पर्वश. Br. II. ११. १६.
--interpreters of the Yajur Veda. They are लोमहर्षणिकस्, काश्यपिकस् and सावर्- णिकस्. वा. ६१. ६०.

--see Yajus;
1: Br. II. ३४. १४-18: M. ९३. १२९; १३३. ३१. वा. २६. २०. ६०. १४, १७, २२; ६१. 5-8; ६५. २५.
divided into four parts from which originated यज्ञ, performed by four orders of priests --अध्वर्यु to recite यजुस्, होत, the र्क्स्, and उद्गात, the सामन्, and ब्रह्मा, the अथर्वमन्त्रस्,
2: Vi. III. 4. 8-१२.
its शाखस् are २७; arranged by वैशम्पायन, pupil of व्यास, and taught to his disciples including याज्ञवल्क्य; the latter was made to vomit for his behaviour, all the texts, which the other disciples digested, in the form of partridges and hence this portion came to be known as तैत्तिरीय; but याज्ञवल्क्य prayed to the Sun-god who initiated him into the other por- tions of the Yajus in the form of a horse and hence called वाजसेनेय;
3: Ib. III. ch. 5 (whole).
part of विष्णु.
4: Ib. V. 1. ३७.

--from the right (south वि। प्।) face of Brah- मा;
1: Br. II. 8. ५१ and ५५; Vi. I. 5. ५४.
one learned in, becomes an expert in यज्ञस्।
2: वा. ७९. ९५.
(V)--the son of Brahmadhana. वा. ६७. २८; ६९. १३२.
--resented शाम्ब's action in seizing लक्ष्- मणा. (s.v.). भा. X. ६८. 5.
--are Graha यज्ञम्, लक्षहोम and कोटि homa. M. २३९. ४०.
--यूप, samit, sruk, sruva, pavitram and paridhi. वा. ९७. २८.
(I)--an आर्षेय pravara; (भार्गव). M. १९५. ४३.

(II)--विष्णु;
1: M. २४६. १०; Vi. I. ११. ४७.
method of meditating on, pre- scribed by the sages to Dhruva.
2: Ib. I. ११. ५२-5.
--(wives of sacrificers) attain salvation by सत्सन्ग। भा. XI. १२. 6.
--a भार्गव gotraka1ra. M. १९५. २३.
--a son of Priyavrata, appointed lord of शाल्- मलिद्वीप. He divided it among his seven sons after whose names the countries came to be known. भा. V. 1. २५ and ३३; २०. 9.
--a मण्डप with forty pillars. M. २७०. 4, ११.
--the four sons of आप, one of the eight Vasus. M. 5. २२.
--a name of ललिता. Br. IV. १३. 7.

--an अवतार् in गोमती तीर्थ;
1: M. २२. १३; २४८. ७७.
वाराहम् रूपम्; the boar described; the Vedas are the feet, upa, teeth; यज्ञ, breast; citi, mouth; fire, tongue; कुश grass, hair; ब्रह्मा, head; day and night, eyes; Vedangas and श्रुतिस्, jewels; ghee, nose; sruva, face; सामघोष, the speech, embodiment of satya and dharma, ऊर्ध्वगात्र, nerves; homa, linga; the residence, ocean; Vedi, the inner body; mantras, the hinder part, soma, blood; Veda, skandha; havi, the smell and pride; havya-kavya fast running; प्राग्वम्श pra1yas4citta, the terrible chariot; the body, दक्स्हिण heart; उपाकर्मेष्ठि, the pleasant form, pravargya materials, orna- ments; different metres footpath, उपनिषद् the seat; छाया wife and tall as मणिसृङ्ग.
2: वा. 6. ११-23.
--the hall of sacrifice in नैमिष; all built of gold. वा. 2. १८.
--a son of Parvasa. वा. २८. १३. [page३-008+ २४]
--symbolical of देवी. Vi. I. 9. १२०.
--(सान्ति karnika) son of शिवस्कन्ध, and father of Vijaya; (द्वियज्ञ-वि। प्।) ruled for १९ years (२९?- म्।प्।). भा. XII. 1. २७; Br. III. ७४. १६८; M. २७३. १४. वा. ९९. ३५५; Vi. IV. २४. ४८.
--the former birth of the twelve याम devas. वा. ३१. 3, 6-7.
--the पाञ्चाल, who invited कृष्ण to Drau- padi's स्वयम्वर। भा. X. ५७. १०. [1].
--a name of द्रौपदी. भा. X. ८४. 1.
(I)--a son of वृष (विष). Br. III. 6. ३४; वा. ६८. ३३.
(II)--a son of ब्रह्मधान (Brahma- danu, वा। प्।). Br. III. 7. ९८; वा. ६९. १३२.
--a son of Uttama Manu. भा. VIII. 1. २३.
--a son of ब्रह्मधान. Br. III. 7. ९८. [page३-009+ २९]
--a भार्गव gotrakara. M. १९५. २४.

--the sacred thread;
1: वा. २३. 3, २६.
of शिव, skin of व्याल.
2: Ib. ५५. ५५.
--a राक्षस with the शिसिर sun; resides in the sun's chariot in the month of फाल्गुन (वि। प्।) Br. II. २३. २२; Vi. II. १०. १८.
--a पारावत god. Br. II. ३६. १५.

(I)--a pupil of बाष्कल(i); taught the त्रयी, to शतानीक;
1: भा. XII. 6. ५५; IX. २२. ३८; Vi. III. 4. १८; IV. २१. 4.
was given the fourth शाख of the ऋग् Veda by his master.
2: वा. ६०. २६.
[page३-025+ ३२]
(III)--(कौशल्य) learnt yoga from हिरण्यनाभ; siddha; disciple of पौष्यञ्जि. भा. IX. १२. 4; VI. १५. १३; Br. III. ६३. २०८; Vi. IV. 4. १०७.
(IV)--a sage who came to see कृष्ण at स्यमन्तपञ्चक. भा. X. ८४. 5.

(V)--as a contemporary of Kalki;
1: Br. III. ७३. १०५.
will precede Kalki.
2: M. ४७. २४९; १९२. १०.
(VI)--a son of ब्रह्मवाह, who won the prize for learning in Janaka's (s.v). hall of sacrifice. वा. ६०. ४१.

(VII)--disqualified;
1: वा. ६१. 1, 6.
learnt the yoga of वसिष्ठ;
2: Ib. ८८. २०८.
purohita of Kalki.
3: Ib. ९८. १०४.
[page३-026+ ३४]
--the portion of the Samhita composed by याज्ञवल्क्य. Br. II. ३५. ७७; वा. ६१. ६८.
--belong to कौशिक gotra. Br. III. ६६. ७०; वा. ९१. ९८.
